title: Do rodent social hierarchy assays measure social dominance or task performance?
title_zh: 啮齿动物社会等级测评是测量社会支配还是任务表现？
abstract: Social hierarchy is a critical variable in rodent models of stress psychopathology and is often assessed using simplified competitive paradigms. These tasks frequently lack sufficient construct validity for social dominance, limiting interpretations of the neural mechanisms underlying social behavior. Advances in behavioral tracking now permit more ethologically grounded assessments of social dominance and provide a superior alternative to study social dominance.
abstract_zh: 社会等级是啮齿动物压力精神病理学模型中的关键变量，通常通过简化的竞争范式进行评估。这些任务往往缺乏足够的构念效度来衡量社会支配，限制了对社会行为神经机制的解释。行为追踪技术的进步现在允许更符合生态学的社会支配评估，并为研究社会支配提供了更优的替代方案。
